classification.scenario_policy_reason: A coastal learning center borrows bahay kubo principles through an elevated shaded floor, a steep ventilated roof, deep overhangs, operable walls, and locally appropriate materials. The design is not a literal hut copy; it translates the climate logic into a safer contemporary section.
